# discord_member (List Resource)

Lists the members of a server in ascending order of user ID. Requires the Server Members privileged intent.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "discord_member" "all" {
  provider         = discord
  include_resource = true
  limit            = 1000

  config {
    server_id = var.server_id
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild) to list members of.
